$comment: The task set for the with/without benchmark (#34), as data rather than as prose in a script.
JSON and not YAML, though the prior art this copies used YAML: this repository has three runtime
dependencies and a promise of no install, and a YAML parser for one file is a fourth. Nothing about
Every identifier here is neutral. The set is dogfooded against private repositories, and
.claude/rules/uic-docs.md is explicit: evidence keeps its numbers and loses its names. `kind` is a
role, never a project's component name, and the repository and the holder it maps onto are supplied
at run time — the same way scripts/first-run.mjs takes repository paths, and for the same reason:
a committed harness cannot carry a repository.
The order is the batch order and it is load-bearing. The claim under test is that the twentieth
screen drifts and the first does not, so the tasks are numbered and both arms write them in this
sequence. Shuffling between arms would measure the shuffle.
The batch runs to 40 because 18 was not enough to answer anything (#63). A count-based drift
curve came back flat over 18 screens in one session, and a flat curve has two readings that call
for opposite responses: the batch is too short, or drift is not positional. `minimumBatch` below
is the first number and is marked as unvalidated, because it came out of an issue body and
nothing has measured where the effect would begin. Run the whole list, not the first fifteen.
